entities.summary: Kim Min-jae was a South Korean baseball player and coach. A shortstop, he played for the Lotte Giants, SK Wyverns and Hanwha Eagles. He batted and threw right-handed. As a coach, he coached the Doosan Bears in the Korea Baseball Organization among others.
